m4.primaryBottleneck: interpretation: The most likely visibility bottleneck is weak search/category relevance and audience signaling on the Shopify App Store listing. observed fact: the listing is in Analytics, the merchant audience is implied but not explicit, and discoveryFit notes say the category may require clearer catalog-audit keywords. interpretation: merchants who would benefit from catalog auditing may not immediately recognize the app as relevant from search/category browsing alone.
m4.competingExplanation: interpretation: A competing explanation is click-through or trust friction after discovery rather than pure discovery weakness. observed fact: the listing has 0 reviews, read-only safety is not prominent near data access context, and copy notes say what happens after opening the app and why access is safe are missing. interpretation: even if discovered, some merchants may hesitate to open because the listing does not reduce perceived risk enough.
m4.researchQuestion: hypothesis: Would making catalog-audit keywords and merchant audience cues more explicit in the title/headline/category-facing copy increase qualified app opens and first scan starts, without changing app behavior?
